nfl.long: Per Reiss, teams are limited to eight players that can be designated to return from the list over the course of the regular season, and the Patriots are close to using them all. "Right now, he's not on injured reserve," Vrabel said Monday. "He's on the active roster, so that's where it is today. I think that those things are obviously fluid. But also, try to manage the roster and do what we need to do to try to win each week." On Sunday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reported that Maye was on track to miss at least six weeks, a timetable that suggests, in a best-case scenario, the QB could make a push for a late-season return or for the postseason, should New England qualify. Heading into a Week 12 game against the Chargers, Tommy DeVito is slated to work as the team's starter, with rookie Behren Morton on hand as his backup. Additionally, there's the possibility that the team considers Daniel Jones -- who the Colts let go Friday -- as an alternative, but Vrabel told Reiss that in the short term at least, adding another signal-caller is not something that's being planned.

nfl.name: Jonathon Brooks
nfl.long: After having his window opened Nov. 11, Brooks was a limited practice participant throughout Week 10 before practicing fully for all three of the Panthers' Week 11 sessions. Canales noted that Chuba Hubbard has thrived of late as the Panthers' lead back, while Trevor Etienne is coming off a positive showing as the top complement to Hubbard in this past Sunday's 35-33 win over the Ravens.
